units.title: Arithmetic Readiness and Repair
units.role: Adaptive support layer with complete instruction for students who need numerical repair.
units.governing_question: What must be dependable about numbers before symbols can carry meaning?
units.story_arc: The learner stabilizes numerical meaning: signed quantities, multiplicative structure, fractions, rates, units, powers, and roots. Diagnostic routing allows a student to enter only the pages needed and then return to the main Algebra spine.
outcomes: Interpret signed numbers as position, direction, and change.
Compute with whole numbers, fractions, decimals, and percentages while estimating plausibility.
Use factors, multiples, ratios, rates, and units structurally.
Interpret powers and roots and use scientific notation.
Recognize when arithmetic output is unreasonable or dimensionally impossible.
sources: Burzynski and Ellis, Fundamentals of Mathematics: complete arithmetic instruction, proficiency exams, and solution-rich practice.
Yoshiwara, Elementary Algebra: just-in-time arithmetic warm-ups tied to later algebraic lessons.
Zaigralin, Basic Algebra with Applications: concise conceptual bridge from arithmetic to algebra.
units.investigation: Compare several phone, grocery, or subscription plans using estimation, rates, percentages, units, and exact calculations.
units.mastery: A ten-domain diagnostic routes each missed strand to one repair lesson followed by a short return check.
